title: P1: Supervisor misses elapsed checks for foreground tools
detail: At edd311a8, a foreground tool running while its agent is working, without a recorded background task or background_parked state, receives no elapsed checkpoint. The eligibility in internal/daemon/attention_checkpoints.go:118 and :186 leaves this case out. Plot s-4kr3bn D3 calls for checkpoints at 20 min, 60 min and 4 h after the last model request for agents working without new requests. Foreground waits past 20 minutes were recorded in s-45t02j/stuck_working.md. This leaves them out of shadow verdicts and the later action path. Cover foreground eligibility and rearm when a new model request arrives. Two readers confirmed the code path; they did not reproduce it live.
